limitations.title: WebKit not verified on this build host
limitations.detail: WebKit fails to launch in ~1ms: 'Host system is missing dependencies to run browsers' (libicu74, libxml2, libflite1). Fails before any test body runs. Never an assumed pass. Playwright projects remain wired (csr-webkit, ssr-hydration-webkit).
limitations.remediation: sudo npx playwright install-deps (or install libicu74/libxml2/libflite1); re-run both Playwright projects.
limitations.gatingEffect: Does NOT block publication of Chromium/Firefox-qualified adapter; WebKit support is unverified until provisioned.

limitations.title: S4 async (server-backed) provenance conservative classification
limitations.detail: While a server-backed setSelectedValues() fetch is in flight, ANY observed change is classified programmatic; a genuine user edit made DURING the fetch window is conservatively NOT reported to the form model (strictly safer than a false echo). Documented in select.component.ts and provenance.ts. PRESERVED and NOT silently classified resolved.
limitations.remediation: Track a precise origin across the await gap (out of S5-Q scope — no production change permitted here).
limitations.gatingEffect: Documented; not a blocker for the common (non-server-backed) forms paths which are fully qualified.

limitations.title: Multi select emits one initial empty change at init
limitations.detail: Core updateConfig() calls clear() on a single->multi mode switch at init, emitting an empty change. Correctly classified programmatic by the adapter (no form-model write-back). Single selects are unaffected.
limitations.remediation: None required; documented so consumers are not surprised by one initial empty change on newly-multi controls.

limitations.title: 44 pre-existing core tsc errors
limitations.detail: npx tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit reports 44 errors, identical to the accepted baseline. Core remediation is a separate NO-GO track (S6).
limitations.gatingEffect: None for the Angular adapter (Angular tsc is 0 errors).
